name: stockdex
description: Read-only stock prices, financial statements, margins, dividends, insider trades and earnings data from Yahoo Finance, Macrotrends, Digrin, Finviz, justETF and Nasdaq.
long_description:
Stockdex gives Claude 24 read-only tools for public market data from Yahoo Finance, Macrotrends, Digrin, Finviz, justETF and Nasdaq: price history and live quotes, financial statements (5 years from Yahoo Finance or about 15 from Macrotrends), margin history and financial ratios, valuation ratios, company profiles, analyst estimates and earnings dates, earnings surprises and price reactions, revenue by segment and region, holders and insider trades, SEC filings, dividends with payout ratio and growth, splits, options chains, and ETF and fund holdings. No account or API key is needed.

**Privacy:** Stockdex runs on your computer. It sends only ticker symbols, search text and request parameters (such as date range, dataset or metric names) to Yahoo Finance, Macrotrends, Digrin and Finviz, and returns their responses to Claude. It does not collect, store or transmit personal data or conversation content, and it does not use telemetry.

**Example prompts**
- "How has Microsoft's stock price moved over the last 6 months?"
- "Show Apple's revenue and net income for the last 15 years."
- "How has NVIDIA's operating margin changed since 2015?"
- "What is Coca-Cola's payout ratio, and how fast is its dividend growing?"
- "How did Tesla's stock react to its last four earnings reports?"
- "Where does Apple's revenue come from by region?"

Stockdex is not investment advice. Data comes from third-party providers and may be delayed, incomplete, rate-limited or blocked.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Daily historical open, high, low, close and volume prices for one ticker from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_financial_statement
tools.description: Annual or quarterly income statement, cash flow or balance sheet figures for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (5 years) or Macrotrends (about 15 years).

tools.name: get_dividends
tools.description: Dividend history from Digrin, or Yahoo Finance as an alternative or fallback.

tools.name: search_ticker
tools.description: Find Yahoo Finance ticker symbols for a company name or partial ticker.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Company profile, key executives and related tickers from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_key_statistics
tools.description: Market cap, P/E, beta, 52-week range, margins and analyst price targets from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_valuation_history
tools.description: Market cap, enterprise value and valuation ratios over time from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_analyst_estimates
tools.description: Analyst EPS and revenue estimates, recommendations, rating changes and earnings surprises from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_earnings_calendar
tools.description: Next earnings date and estimates, ex-dividend and dividend payment dates from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_holders
tools.description: Institutional and fund holders, ownership breakdown and insider transactions from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_sec_filings
tools.description: Recent SEC filings with form type, title and links from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_fund_holdings
tools.description: Top holdings, sector weights and asset allocation of ETFs and mutual funds from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_fund_profile
tools.description: Fund family, category, expense ratio and performance vs category for ETFs and mutual funds from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_splits
tools.description: Stock split history from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_option_expirations
tools.description: Listed option expiration dates for one ticker from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_etf_profile
tools.description: Basics, price, top holdings, countries and sectors of a European ETF by ISIN from justETF.

tools.name: get_quarterly_fundamentals
tools.description: Long quarterly histories of assets, debt, cash flow, income, expenses and shares from Digrin.

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description: Options chain for one expiration date from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_quotes
tools.description: Current quotes for up to 20 symbols from Yahoo Finance.

tools.name: get_margins_and_ratios
tools.description: Gross, operating, EBITDA, pre-tax and net margin history and key financial ratios from Macrotrends.

tools.name: get_dividend_metrics
tools.description: Dividend payout ratio and growth projections from Digrin, and annual dividend, yield and payout history from Finviz.

tools.name: get_revenue_breakdown
tools.description: Annual revenue by business segment, region or product from Finviz.

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.description: Recent insider buys and sales with price, shares and value from Finviz.

tools.name: get_earnings_reaction
tools.description: Price reaction to earnings, EPS and revenue surprises, and estimate revisions from Finviz.
